turn: The plugin manifest format step is finished, and I committed it as "feat(manifest): validate manifest fields". I added `validateManifest` in `src/manifest/validate.ts`. It takes a `PluginManifest` and returns a list of error strings instead of throwing, so callers can report every problem at once. It currently checks two things: that `name` is present, and that `apiVersion` matches the exported `HOST_API_VERSION`, which is 1. I haven't run anything to check it. I only reread the function against the manifest type, so it has no test coverage yet. In the same commit I also fixed a small, unrelated problem I noticed: a relative import in the manifest module was missing its `.js` extension, which would have broken resolution under ESM. Next I'll start on "Loader for local plugins".

sidefix.title: Add missing .js import extension
sidefix.what: Fixed a relative import in the manifest module that lacked the .js extension required for ESM resolution.
